'''Josh Wendt''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 58 from Bozeman, Mt. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He played and ran tournaments in Bozeman from the 1996 Regionals, and sang professionally with a Bozeman opera company.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
